articles.t: 'GTA 6' on PC: What we know about the PC release
articles.chapeau: Rockstar's highly anticipated sequel launches on consoles only this November, leaving PC players waiting.
articles.txt:
Grand Theft Auto VI will be a PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S console exclusive at launch, with no confirmed PC release date. Given Rockstar's history with PC ports, we originally thought gamers were in for a long wait.
An October 2026 report from gaming business media site Gamesbeat reveals a potential PC launch in early 2027, which is sooner than we expected.
The game likely cost $1 to $3 billion to produce, so Rockstar may be eager to recoup its costs with a faster GTA 6 PC release date.
The highly anticipated Grand Theft Auto VI is set to launch on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S on Nov. 19, 2026, but PC players will have to wait. Rockstar has confirmed that the game is console-only at launch, with no PC version officially announced at this time.
Despite that, we recently got some good news: GamesBeat reports that GTA 6 will get a PC release sometime in Q1 of 2027. GamesBeat has a good track record with unannounced news like this. According to their reporting, the GTA 6 PC release window was confirmed by industry sources familiar with Rockstar's plans. They spoke with the outlet under the condition of anonymity.
Rockstar and Take-Two haven't given an official reason for skipping PC at launch, but a few factors are typically cited when publishers stagger releases this way.
Console hardware is standardized, which tends to make optimization more straightforward than building for the huge range of PC configurations. Some industry data has also indicated that consoles generate higher per-unit revenue, giving publishers an incentive to front-load console sales.
A more cynical take is that Take-Two could just be double-dipping, hoping fans who can't wait for the PC launch will buy the console first, then buy the PC version later. A PC Gamer poll found that 39 percent of respondents said they're fine waiting for a port rather than needing it on day one, suggesting a meaningful share of the PC audience isn't treating the delay as a dealbreaker.
However, there could be another, less financially motivated reason for all of this.
Speaking to YouTuber KiwiTalkz , former Rockstar producer John Ricchio explained that building for consoles first and scaling up to PC is technically easier than the reverse, since consoles have fixed, predictable hardware. According to IGN , Ricchio said it's simpler to start with tighter constraints and add polish later than to build a PC-first game and then try to trim it down to fit console limitations.
Without an official release date, gamers have had to speculate on the most likely launch window for a GTA 6 PC version.
If you look at several past Rockstar games, you can see that there's typically a significant amount of time between the console launch and the PC port.
Grand Theft Auto 4 was released in April 2008 and didn't reach PC's until that December. Grand Theft Auto V was released in Sept. 2013, and its PC counterpart was released 19 months later in April 2015. Red Dead Redemption 2 arrived on PC roughly a year after its console release.
The one exception was Grand Theft Auto: The Trilogy – The Definitive Edition , which launched simultaneously across platforms in 2021. Based on that track record, a GTA 6 PC port, if it follows the usual pattern, could be a year or more away.
A recent report from The Verge claimed that Xbox would have exclusive rights to stream GTA 6 via its cloud gaming service at launch. The report noted that PC gamers would be able to play GTA 6 on day one after all , despite Rockstar's lack of news about a potential release window for a PC port. Unfortunately, Xbox Gaming's Chief Strategy Officer, Matthew Ball, shot down this report. Ball wrote on his personal X account that The Verge's coverage led to some "misreporting."
Per Ball, not only is GTA 6 not being exclusively streamed by Xbox, but it will not be available to stream on PC at launch either.
Fortunately, the report from GamesBeat indicates gamers may not have to wait a full year for a PC release, though that report remains unconfirmed. Recommended deals for you HBO Max — top pick for premium content

articles.t: GTA 6 locks in Nov. 19 release date after delays
articles.chapeau: Rockstar's GTA 6 is set for release Nov. 19, with digital preloads starting Nov. 12.
articles.txt:
MOBILE, Ala. ( WALA ) - Details on what is expected to be the biggest game of the year.
Grand Theft Auto VI finally has a locked-in release date — Nov. 19 — after a series of delays.
Rockstar Games confirmed the date in a new launch trailer. Digital preloads begin a week early on Nov. 12. Preorders opened earlier this summer, and fans have been dissecting the cover art frame by frame.
Wall Street analysts estimate the game cost more than $1 billion to make, which would position it as the most expensive video game ever created.
The game centers on Jason and Lucia in a hyper-polished Vice City. Lucia is the franchise’s first playable female protagonist of the modern era, and the pair have a modern-day Bonnie-and-Clyde dynamic.
The trailer expands on their backstories. New footage hints at an Army background for Jason that brings heavy tactical gear into the mix. Lucia starts out fresh on parole, wearing an ankle monitor in several scenes.
The atmosphere is backed by an original score from French electronic duo Justice.
With its billion-dollar budget, dual-protagonist crime story and Vice City setting, the launch is shaping up as a massive cultural event.

'GTA 6' reportedly has realistic sweat. Here's how it works.
articles.chapeau: Of course it does.
articles.txt:
Rockstar Games' games tend to be full of little details that players might barely notice (if at all), and it sounds like Grand Theft Auto VI is no different.
Bloomberg reporter Jason Schreier published a deep dive into the development history of GTA 6 this week, complete with an accompanying YouTube video that explores key aspects of the story that didn't make it into print. One such aspect is a realistic sweat system that Rockstar apparently developed for the game. According to Schreier, protagonists Jason and Lucia will develop believable amounts of sweat depending on the physical activity they're doing.
Examples include working out in gyms or dancing in nightclubs. If you perform actions like that, Jason and Lucia will get a little moist, as you'd expect in the real world. Details like the sweat mechanic help explain why GTA 6 took nearly a decade to finish. It's also perfectly in character for Rockstar, as the company also previously developed a realistic horse testicle shrinkage system for cold weather in Red Dead Redemption II .
Yes, you read that right. And, no, I will not elaborate further. As a reminder, GTA 6 launches on Nov. 19, and you can preorder the game now for Xbox Series X/S and PlayStation 5 . Recommended deals for you HBO Max — top pick for premium content

articles.t: New GTA 6 Cyberleek video has story clips and one NSFW detail
articles.chapeau: We're not joking about the NSFW part.
articles.txt:
We thought we were done with notorious Grand Theft Auto VI leaker known only as Cyberleek , but we were proven wrong on Thursday with a fresh GTA 6 leak.
The still-anonymous leaker (or group of leakers) posted their first update since late August, in the form of a nearly 25-minute-long video that's easy enough to find on social media. It's our most detailed look yet at the hotly anticipated game from Rockstar, at least outside of the official "Extended Look" that aired on Netflix in August.
If you manage to find the video, be warned: Major portions of it are strictly not safe for work. It includes a lot of footage of Jason, the male protagonist, walking around completely nude, and everything is modeled in full detail. It's unclear if this is something you can actually do in the final game, or if Cyberleek used some kind of developer tools to pull it off. There are a couple of bits of evidence pointing to the latter; NPCs do not react at all to Jason's nudity, and at one point, the person playing the leaked build spawns a tank out of thin air, suggesting capabilities beyond what normal players will be able to do.
There is also a very brief clip of Lucia, the game's other protagonist, who is seen mostly nude at the very end of the video. There was some speculation earlier in the week that nudity would be part of the game, and it seems like it's at least partially confirmed now.
Beyond the NSFW bits, nothing in the video is all that surprising. We see a couple of different vehicular races, both of which are pre-empted by cutscenes introducing the characters in charge of racing in the countryside and on city streets. These cutscenes aren't especially spoiler-heavy, but if you're really precious about not seeing them ahead of release, you should probably avoid Cyberleek's latest GTA 6 leaks.
We also get a brief look at vehicle customization, which includes the ability to upgrade the engine, transmission, and other aspects of cars. There's also some footage of the game being played in first-person, both while driving and walking around. This was a popular feature Rockstar added to GTA 5 years after release (and incorporated into Red Dead Redemption II ), but it hasn't been shown in GTA 6 yet.

À Un Jour Près, GTA 6 Pourra Finalement Concourir Au Titre De Jeu De L’année 2026
articles.chapeau: GTA 6 sortira le 19 novembre, juste avant la date limite du 20 novembre fixée pour prétendre au GOTY lors des Game Awards 2026.
articles.txt:
Le calendrier pouvait priver le prochain blockbuster de Rockstar du plus grand trophée de l’année. Sa sortie fixée au 19 novembre lui laisse finalement une marge minuscule face à la date couperet.
La FAQ actualisée des Game Awards précise qu’un jeu doit être commercialisé au plus tard le vendredi 20 novembre à 21 heures, heure du Pacifique , pour être éligible à l’édition 2026. Attendu le 19 novembre sur PS5 et Xbox Series X|S, GTA 6 entre donc dans la fenêtre avec seulement un jour d’avance.
La date du 19 novembre s’inscrit aussi dans un calendrier commercial déjà balisé, avec des précommandes de GTA 6 prévues dès le 25 juin avant le lancement sur consoles.
La version PC, dont la sortie serait prévue au premier trimestre 2027, ne pèsera pas dans cette sélection. La cérémonie se tiendra le 10 décembre au Peacock Theater de Los Angeles.
L’éligibilité ne garantit évidemment aucune nomination. Les candidats sont choisis par un jury composé de plus de 100 médias et créateurs de contenu, qui devront avoir suffisamment joué au titre avant la clôture des votes.
Ce calendrier serré place les conditions de test au centre du dossier. Rockstar protège étroitement le projet contre les fuites, avec notamment un lancement annoncé comme entièrement numérique, tandis qu’une personne affirmant détenir une version complète menace actuellement de la diffuser si Take-Two ne présente pas ses excuses.
Un précédent rapport évoquait des tests réservés à un événement fermé, organisé sur place. Plus récemment, l’insider NateTheHate a indiqué que les copies destinées à la presse devraient être distribuées avant la fin octobre, une information que ni Rockstar ni Take-Two n’ont confirmée.
Si ce calendrier se vérifie, les jurés disposeront de quelques semaines pour évaluer le jeu avant leur vote. Cette avance serait déterminante pour transformer une éligibilité acquise de justesse en candidature crédible au titre de jeu de l’année.

articles.t: GTA 6 outclassed by 95% Positive indie; collector's edition confirms physical copy and free 'buddy code'
articles.chapeau: Even indies are doing it better...
articles.txt:
GTA 6 and other 2026 AAAs are being embarrassed by an indie with a better collector's edition.
Grand Theft Auto VI is the game everyone’s excited for this year, but even Rockstar’s next masterpiece isn’t beyond criticism.
The next Grand Theft Auto game dropped its launch trailer earlier today and gave us a closer look at its new protagonists Jason and Lucia, though not as close as Cyberleeks’ nude gameplay showcase …
As exciting as the new game is, some fans are still salty about its disappointing collector’s edition, which has joined a number of other AAA titles by not including a physical copy. It’s now being shown up by an indie game of all things.
The co-op climbing game Peak became one of Steam’s best-rated games last year and is currently sitting pretty with a 95% Positive rating on the platform.
Now after a long wait the game is finally coming to the PlayStation 5, and even had a collector’s edition that’s outshining both GTA VI and God of War: Laufey .
The collector’s edition contains a passport kit, a physical copy of the game and a ‘buddy pass’. This is like the Friends Pass you can get for games like Split Fiction and Orbitals, but it’s even better because it acts as a full, second copy of the game. Meaning both players can play separately if they wish.
Even better is the since-deleted listing for the collector’s edition on VGP priced the game at $21.09, which is a bargain if that’s the actual price.
In any case it’s a better deal than what other companies are offering. GTA VI’s Goodtime State – Vice City Collection costs $400 and features just about anything but the actual game. Seriously you get a crocodile figurine, a hat, a bag, sunglasses etc, but not even the digital download code.
READ NEXT: GTA 6 release time, preload date, download size and editions
Even God of War: Laufey is guilty of a dodgy collector’s edition . It was revealed earlier this week and features a statue of Faye (which lights up), Oracle cards and an art book. Be warned though, it also comes with a spoiler for the game!
Like GTA VI’s bumper box it also features no physical copy or download code, though to be fair that’s to be expected of PlayStation from now. Sony is phasing out discs entirely in the next couple of years, remember?
Two of the hottest AAAs yet to release and neither of them offer a copy of the game, whereas an indie title made by a small studio offers two copies.
It’d be funny if it wasn't so disappointing. Collector’s Editions are so rarely worth the money these days and that’s largely because they lack the entire reason you’d want to buy one to begin with; the game.
The PS5 version of Peak will launch on October 22. It's also coming to Xbox Series X/S and Nintendo Switch 2 with crossplay included.

articles.t: Massive GTA 6 Banner In Paris Censors All Of The Guns
articles.chapeau: Grand Theft Auto is a franchise that famously includes guns, but this big advertisement for it in Paris cut them out
articles.txt:
Grand Theft Auto 6 is just weeks away from launching on PS5 and Xbox. As we get closer to that November 19 launch date, Rockstar’s marketing is kicking into full gear, including a new trailer, multiple cover stories, and merchandise. It also means there are murals and banners popping up around the globe. Though in Paris, you might notice some guns missing from one massive GTA 6 banner.
Over the last two weeks, people online have been documenting the progress on a massive banner advertisement for Grand Theft Auto 6 being attached to one of the Les Mercuriales towers in Paris, France. And on Thursday , it was reported that work had wrapped up on the big banner, which recreates the GTA 6 cover art on the side of the building. However, as pointed out by some fans, this artwork has been tweaked slightly to remove two different guns .
As you can see in the comparison above, Lucia’s gun has been removed from the top middle image of her and Jason. Meanwhile, an assault rifle has been removed from the bottom middle image of the official cover art as well. In Lucia’s case, her hand and the gun were removed. In the other example, it seems the artwork has been tweaked to just have the character’s hand in the air with no gun in front of it.
Other banners and murals that have gone up in the United States, like this one in NYC, have artwork featuring guns.
A perspective I hadn't seen of the GTA mural shows how close it is to the NYC skyline by u/GameDrain in GTA6
But apparently over in Paris, the people who own this tower aren’t too keen on having giant guns slapped on the side of the building. Though they’re more than fine taking the cash to advertise a game with guns in it. Or maybe there are some advertising restrictions on guns in Paris that I’m not aware of. Either way, it’s all a bit silly.

articles.t: EXCLUSIVE: The Impact GTA 6 Is Having on Digital Gaming Storefronts Like G2A
articles.chapeau: We caught up with G2A.COM to learn about how the platform is preparing for the imminent arrival of Grand Theft Auto 6.
articles.txt:
Grand Theft Auto 6 will be the fastest-selling game of all time. That’s not even ‘a safe assumption’; it’s almost an honest-to-God guarantee at this point. It’s expected to put immense strain on global internet infrastructure, come under threat from a cybersecurity perspective, and deliver an unparalleled, mind-blowing experience to tens of millions of gamers from day one.
It’s also set to have a major impact on digital storefronts, given that the game won’t have a disc at launch. With that in mind, most folks are omitting the code-in-a-box concept in favor of just downloading the game, and that means that sites like G2A are ready to feel the burn.
I recently caught up with G2A’s Head of Sales Partnerships and New Business, Katarzyna Jakubiec, to learn about the impact GTA 6 has already had on their platform.
It’s no big secret that the gaming world is becoming increasingly digital , and that means sites like G2A are flourishing. This is arguably the leading digital gaming store, offering codes for games, credit, and other associated items at often heavily discounted prices to customers around the world.
I asked Katarzyna Jakubiec about the impact they’ve already seen from the imminent release of Grand Theft Auto 6.
We are seeing that many players are actively embracing a digital-first future. During the pre-sale period [of GTA 6], purchases of PlayStation gift cards on G2A.COM reached record levels and have continued to grow as anticipation for the launch builds.
The company understands that physical media is still important to many gamers, but recognizes that ‘the growth of digital shows that players are clearly embracing new ways of accessing games.’
In terms of preparing for GTA 6, G2A.COM carried out multiple surveys to better determine how to build out their offering to accommodate the inevitable influx.
What we have found is that GTA VI is shaping to be a major retail and cultural moment, and the level of interest we’re seeing on G2A.COM reflects that. For example, when Rockstar Games’ pre-orders opened, traffic to GTA VI offer pages increased 65-fold.
Internally, we’re preparing for a series of engagement waves rather than a single launch-day peak. GTA VI became G2A.COM’s most wishlisted offer in 45 countries, including the UK and US, and ranked in the top 10 overall in 46 countries. This clearly indicates interest is building across multiple markets and will continue to grow as we get closer to the launch date.
Jakubiec stressed that they’re not just getting ready for day one , but for the long tail that follows.
They’re planning to support gamers, including the later adopters, long into GTA 6’s lifecycle: ‘While just over half of surveyed users plan to start playing within the first 24 hours, others intend to take a more gradual approach. By tracking these different patterns of demand, we can ensure we are prepared not only for the initial launch period, but also for the continued interest that is likely to follow.’
Many gamers will flock to G2A.COM in the hope of getting a deal on their games. That’s often the case with the site, which offers even brand-new games at discounted prices. In Jakubiec’s words, it’s about accessibility, and that’s the ethos of their operating model:
Gaming should stay within everyone’s reach, even as family budgets get tighter and game prices go up. We’re helping connect users to a global marketplace where they can compare offers from different sellers and pick what fits their pocket best.
Grand Theft Auto 6 will be released worldwide on November 19th. How are you preparing to buy the game? Let us know on the Insider Gaming Discord server .

articles.t: 'Grand Theft Auto 6' in-game radio stations and podcasts detailed by Rockstar
articles.chapeau: Some would say this is the most important part of 'GTA 6.'
articles.txt:
With just over a month until Grand Theft Auto VI launches and America experiences an unprecedented flood of PTO requests , Rockstar has given us another taste of the game's musical identity.
The GTA VI developer posted an entry on its official website detailing several of the game's in-game radio stations, giving us an idea of what to expect both in terms of music and their interstitial talking bits. The six stations detailed in the blog post are as follows:
Cocoteo FM: A Latin radio station for all your reggaeton and merengue needs.
Back Country Radio: A country radio station with hosts including Morgan Wallen, Lana Del Rey, and Jeremy Dufrene.
AfroBank FM: A station devoted to African music from across the decades, up until now.
The Chamber 106.6: The requisite '80s-and-beyond metal station, with hosts Tom Araya and Kerry King of Slayer.
Flash FM: A pop station that seems to be the only holdover from GTA: Vice City so far, hosted by Robyn and model Alex Consani.
Dirty South Classics: A Southern rap station, naturally, hosted by Trick Daddy and Trina.
Interestingly, you can sample each of these stations on a separate page on Rockstar's website . People on social media have also already started compiling every song that's been confirmed on the radio so far. That's on top of what we've heard on the official soundtrack album and what we heard in the Netflix trailer that aired in August.
Rockstar's blog post did not go into much detail about this, but there are apparently also on-demand in-game podcasts for Jason and Lucia to listen to. Both podcasts and radio stations can be listened to either while driving or walking around, the latter being justified by earbuds that connect to the protagonists' smartphones.

While we all count down the days until we can finally hit the streets of Vice City, Rockstar Games is letting us dress the part right now. The official Grand Theft Auto VI merch collection is live on the Rockstar Store, packing the iconic neon pink, ocean blue, and palm-tree aesthetic of Leonida into apparel, accessories, and heavy-duty collectibles.
Whether you want to rep the game subtly with low-key Vice City logos or go all-in with a $400 collector's box , Rockstar dropped something for every budget level. To help you skip the fluff and grab the best pieces before they sell out, we rounded up the standout items from the new collection.

If you prefer keeping the sun out of your eyes in pure Vice City style, the Grand Theft Auto VI Baseball Cap features a bright blue stretch-fitted cotton build accented by an embroidered pink VI palm tree logo up front and a matching Rockstar logo along the side.
Moving over to carry gear, the Pink and Blue Tote features heavy-duty canvas in custom Vice City pink, pairing iconic franchise logos with built-in interior organization, including a laptop sleeve and three dedicated bottle slots. For a smaller accessory that packs pure retro crime-boss energy, the Vice City Zippo Lighter delivers a classic, refillable, polished-chrome body laser-etched with Vice City and Rockstar logos on opposing sides.

articles.t: GTA 6 dévoile son trailer de lancement avec de nouvelles images des missions - Dexerto
articles.chapeau: Rockstar vient de dévoiler le trailer de lancement de GTA 6 avec de nouvelles missions, des révélations sur Jason et Lucia et plus encore.
articles.txt:
GTA GTA 6 dévoile son trailer de lancement avec de nouvelles images des missions par Ludovic Quinson Publié : 15 oct. 2026, 13:15 Sauvegarder pour plus tard Sauvegarder pour plus tard Rockstar Games Ajouter comme source préférée sur Google Suivre sur Google News À quelques semaines de la sortie de GTA 6 , Rockstar Games vient de publier le troisième trailer du jeu, offrant un aperçu inédit de l’histoire de Jason et Lucia, mais aussi de plusieurs missions qui attendent les joueurs à Vice City.
Après un deuxième trailer principalement consacré aux personnages et un large aperçu riche en gameplay , cette nouvelle vidéo permet d’en découvrir davantage sur les événements qui rythmeront l’aventure.
Cette troisième bande-annonce revient notamment sur le passé militaire de Jason, un élément de son histoire personnelle qui devrait jouer un rôle dans le scénario.
Sa relation avec Lucia occupe également une place importante. Les nouvelles séquences confirment notamment que cette dernière porte un bracelet électronique à la cheville, un détail qui avait déjà alimenté plusieurs théories au sein de la communauté.
Mais Rockstar ne s’est pas contenté de dévoiler de nouvelles cinématiques. Le trailer présente également des passages de missions, dont une spectaculaire opération impliquant des hélicoptères et une partie d’un coffre-fort transportée dans les airs.
La publication de ce trailer intervient alors que Rockstar approche de l’échéance fixée pour son jeu, après plusieurs reports qui ont prolongé l’attente des fans.
Ces nouvelles images arrivent également dans un contexte marqué par les récentes fuites de Cyberleek . Le leaker a annoncé suspendre ses publications après avoir diffusé des séquences qu’il présente comme issues des dernières missions, tout en affirmant posséder des spoilers sur la conclusion du scénario .

De son côté, Rockstar poursuit sa communication officielle en mettant davantage en avant les personnages , les missions et l’ univers de Leonida . Pour rappel, GTA 6 sortira le 19 novembre 2026 sur PS5 et Xbox Series X|S.

articles.t: GTA VII : le jeu vidéo est-il déjà en préparation ? Le studio Rockstar dévoile de premiers indices
articles.chapeau: GTA VII est déjà en développement ?
articles.txt:
GTA VII : le jeu vidéo est-il déjà en préparation ? Le studio Rockstar dévoile de premiers indices Publié le 15 octobre 2026 à 22 h 00 Par Maxence Grosvalet
© Rockstar games Douze ans après la parution du dernier Grand Theft Auto ( GTA ), la sortie du prochain GTA VI n’a jamais été aussi proche. Avant même sa sortie, prévue pour le 19 novembre, le prochain titre du studio Rockstar est déjà un phénomène planétaire. Pour autant, les joueurs devront-ils attendre encore dix ans avant de découvrir un nouveau jeu vidéo ou est-il déjà en préparation ? Les développeurs ont donné quelques indices sur le futur du studio.
C’est le jeu vidéo le plus attendu de l’histoire du gaming. Avant même sa sortie, Grand Theft Auto VI ( GTA VI ) est un véritable phénomène planétaire. Pour ce nouvel opus, le studio Rockstar a donc décidé d’emmener ses fans au cœur de la ville fictive de Vice City, inspirée de Miami. L’histoire se concentrera sur une version plus moderne de Bonnie et Clyde : Jason et Lucia.
En plus de proposer diverses activités secondaires et une histoire toujours plus haletante, GTA VI promet également un sentiment de liberté jusqu’à présent jamais atteint dans la saga . Il faut dire que, pour développer ce jeu vidéo, les équipes de Rockstar ont eu besoin de pas moins de douze années. Alors que les fans attendent le 19 novembre prochain avec impatience, une question reste toutefois sur toutes les lèvres : faudra-t-il encore attendre dix ans avant de découvrir le prochain GTA VII ?
Douze ans. C’est le temps dont le studio Rockstar a eu besoin pour passer de GTA V à GTA VI . Et encore, le jeu vidéo a vu sa sortie être décalée à plusieurs reprises avant d’être finalement fixée au 19 novembre prochain. Il faut dire que le développement de ce nouveau jeu vidéo est loin d’avoir été une partie de plaisir. Tout d’abord, le studio Rockstar a dû renforcer les équipes allouées au projet Red Dead Redemption 2 , car le titre a demandé plus d’efforts que prévu avant sa sortie.
De plus, Rockstar a connu de grandes difficultés lors de la pandémie mondiale de COVID-19 . Le télétravail a en effet beaucoup perturbé le fonctionnement du studio de jeux vidéo, qui a donc pris pas mal de retard durant cette période. Ajoutez à cela de nombreux efforts pour mettre au point un jeu vidéo toujours plus beau et ambitieux , et vous obtenez en partie des explications concernant cette longue attente.
Pour de nombreux joueurs, ces douze années d’attente ont été insoutenables, ce qui explique en partie pourquoi GTA VI est tant attendu. Beaucoup de fans redoutent donc déjà de devoir attendre de nouveau plusieurs années avant d’avoir accès au prochain GTA VII , ou même au prochain opus du studio Rockstar en général. Lors d’une interview accordée au média Bloomberg , les responsables du développement, Phil Hooker et Aaron Garbut, sont revenus sur le sujet.
Selon eux, GTA VI a nécessité beaucoup de travail car ils voulaient qu’il serve de base pour tous les prochains jeux vidéo du studio . « Le moteur, les outils et l’équipe que nous avons constitués au cours de ce projet nous permettront d’avancer plus vite » explique Phil Hooker. « Je suis convaincu que nous pouvons nous appuyer sur ces acquis et explorer davantage les différentes facettes de notre stratégie pour créer un contenu encore plus captivant » poursuit-il.
De son côté, Aaron Garbut a affirmé que l’équipe avait aussi gagné une « compréhension et des connaissances partagées » , ce qui leur permet d’avoir « une sorte de raccourci pour répondre aux questions » et d’aller plus vite. S’ils n’ont pas précisé quel serait le prochain titre du studio , une chose est sûre : Rockstar devrait bientôt refaire parler de lui.

articles.chapeau: Le duo Justice a travaillé pendant 3 ans sur la bande originale du jeu vidéo le plus attendu de l'année : GTA 6 !
articles.txt:
C’est la (très) bonne nouvelle du jour ! Le duo Justice a travaillé pendant 3 ans sur la bande originale du jeu vidéo le plus attendu de l’année : GTA 6 ! Et le duo a déjà dévoilé un nouveau titre.
Après les Daft Punk dans Fortnite, un autre groupe de la French Touch s’offre un autre jeu vidéo populaire ! Justice a été recruté par le Studio Rockstar Games , afin de produire la Bande Originale de son prochain GTA 6 . Et oui, nos 2 français sont derrière la BO du jeu vidéo le plus attendu de l’année 2026. La musique ayant toujours été un élément central de la franchise, on ne peut que saluer cette décision artistique ! Justice a travaillé près de 3 ans sur cet énorme projet, qui doit sortir dans quelques semaines.
Pour fêter cette actualité, Justice a dévoilé « Flower In A Hurricane « , qu’on retrouve d’ailleurs dans la dernière bande annonce de GTA 6 . Ce nouveau morceau est en compagnie de SZA, King Gizzard , The Lizard Wizard ainsi que Tame Impala . Un album regroupant les titres présents dans GTA 6 doit également sortir, avec notamment « Sexy Magic « , la collab’ entre Fred Again .. et Etienne de Crécy !

Rockstar Games soigne aussi ses oreilles. La bande-annonce de lancement de Grand Theft Auto VI ( GTA 6 ) s’accompagne d’un nouveau morceau signé Justice, le duo électronique français impliqué dans la bande-son originale du jeu. De quoi faire monter la pression avant de retrouver les routes de Leonida.
Baptisé « Flower in a Hurricane » , le titre est interprété par Justice, avec Tame Impala, SZA et King Gizzard & the Lizard Wizard. Un casting musical éclectique pour accompagner les nouvelles images de GTA 6. Ici, pas besoin de voler une voiture pour profiter du morceau.

Avec Justice aux commandes de ce nouveau titre, Rockstar poursuit cette tradition. Reste à découvrir comment la musique accompagnera les aventures de Jason et Lucia dans GTA 6.

articles.txt:
Après Guy-Manuel de Homem-Christo (Daft Punk), le duo français Justice prend les commandes de la bande originale du jeu vidéo GTA 6.
La French Touch s’installe définitivement au cœur du prochain blockbuster de Rockstar Games . Alors que la présence de Guy-Manuel de Homem-Christo , cofondateur de Daft Punk , avait déjà suscité un vif enthousiasme lors de l’annonce de sa production sur le single RHYNO de Travis Scott , le studio de développement confirme un autre grand nom de la scène électronique française. Gaspard Augé et Xavier de Rosnay , les deux membres du groupe Justice , ont été choisis pour composer la bande originale du jeu vidéo.
Cette annonce s’accompagne de la sortie immédiate d’un morceau intitulé Flower in a Hurricane . Disponible en tant que single autonome du duo, cette composition rassemble SZA , Tame Impala ainsi que le groupe australien King Gizzard & the Lizard Wizard . Ce titre figurera directement sur l’album officiel Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album , édité en partenariat avec Atlantic Records .
Prévue pour le 19 novembre 2026 , la bande originale regroupera trente-quatre pistes inédites spécialement créées pour l’univers du jeu . Le déploiement musical se poursuit à un rythme soutenu avant le lancement, à l’image des récents extraits partagés par l’éditeur, dont Don’t Chart de Cardi B et Suzuki de Fuerza Regida , qui ont rejoint les morceaux déjà dévoilés de Yung Lean , Future , Metro Boomin , Morgan Wallen , Rauw Alejandro , Keith Richards , ainsi que la collaboration réunissant Etienne de Crécy , Fred again .., PinkPantheress et CA7RIEL & Paco Amoroso .
L’intégralité du disque sera disponible en même temps que le jeu vidéo le 19 novembre 2026 . Diverses éditions physiques, incluant des formats CD et plusieurs déclinaisons vinyles, sont proposées en précommande sur la boutique officielle et chez différents revendeurs partenaires.

articles.t: Les premiers tests de GTA 6 sont imminents, une excellente nouvelle pour les joueurs impatients
articles.chapeau: Attendus depuis des années, les premiers tests de GTA 6 tomberont avant la sortie du 19 novembre 2026. Assez tôt pour rassurer – ou faire douter – les joueurs français.
articles.txt:
Attendus depuis des années, les premiers tests de GTA 6 tomberont avant la sortie du 19 novembre 2026. Assez tôt pour rassurer – ou faire douter – les joueurs français.
Les tests de GTA 6 arrivent plus vite que prévu. Alors que le jeu de Rockstar Games sort le 19 novembre 2026 sur PlayStation 5 et Xbox Series X|S , plusieurs sources concordantes indiquent que les reviews complètes seront publiées avant le lancement, une première à ce niveau pour la licence.
Jusqu’ici, certains imaginaient un lancement sans notes, porté uniquement par la hype. Le site Insider Gaming affirme pourtant avoir appris que les critiques « will go live before the release on November 19 » et que « the content will drop before the game is in your hands (digitally) ». De quoi changer la façon dont les joueurs français vont aborder ce 19 novembre.
Grand Theft Auto VI arrivera au prix conseillé de 79,99 € sur console, avec un préchargement attendu le 12 novembre. Aucune bêta, démo ni accès anticipé n’a été annoncée : avant la sortie, seules les rédactions et créateurs accrédités toucheront à la version finale, sous embargo strict.
Insider Gaming parle d’un embargo déjà fixé en interne, susceptible d’être ajusté, mais confirmé comme antérieur au 19 novembre. De son côté, l’insider NateTheHate avance que les copies presse pourraient être envoyées avant la fin octobre, laissant plus de trois semaines pour parcourir un open world annoncé comme massif .
Historiquement, les tests de Grand Theft Auto V et de Red Dead Redemption 2 sont tombés la veille de la sortie, pour un résultat identique : 97/100 sur Metacritic . Si GTA 6 casse ce schéma avec des reviews publiées plus tôt, les joueurs auront enfin le temps d’analyser à froid la technique, le frame rate, la densité du contenu ou la durée de la campagne avant de dépenser 79,99 €.
Les prévisions évoquent jusqu’à 50 millions de ventes la première semaine, ce qui rend ces retours critiques encore plus stratégiques. Le patron de Take-Two Interactive , Strauss Zelnick , rappelle d’ailleurs que la réception critique et la moyenne Metacritic restent centrales pour GTA 6 . Pour les joueurs impatients, ces notes seront un filtre précieux dans un flot de trailers spectaculaires et de fuites parfois contradictoires .
Concrètement, aucun score n’apparaît encore sur Metacritic ou OpenCritic , tous deux affichant « tbd ». L’embargo officiel n’est pas public, mais la combinaison d’Insider Gaming et des insiders laisse imaginer une fenêtre de tests début ou mi-novembre. Avant cette date, tout « test » ou toute « note » doit être considérée comme suspecte.
La montée en puissance devrait donc ressembler à ceci : envoi des copies presse fin octobre, premières reviews quelques jours avant le 19 novembre, préchargement le 12 novembre, puis sortie mondiale à minuit. En parallèle, Malwarebytes a déjà repéré de faux sites promettant démo ou « extended look » de GTA 6 qui installent des malwares. Tant que Rockstar Games n’aura pas levé son embargo, la seule bonne réaction pour un joueur impatient restera de surveiller ses médias habituels et les agrégateurs officiels, plutôt que de cliquer sur des « tests » miraculeusement en avance.

articles.chapeau: GTA 6 intègre un système de transpiration réaliste qui évolue en temps réel selon les efforts de Jason et Lucia.
articles.txt:
GTA GTA 6 pousse le réalisme jusqu’à simuler la transpiration de ses personnages par Ludovic Quinson Publié : 15 oct. 2026, 10:08 Sauvegarder pour plus tard Sauvegarder pour plus tard Rockstar Games Ajouter comme source préférée sur Google Suivre sur Google News Rockstar continue de repousser les limites du réalisme avec GTA 6 , jusque dans des détails auxquels les joueurs ne prêteront peut-être même pas attention. Le studio a notamment développé un système capable de faire varier la transpiration de Jason et Lucia en fonction de leurs efforts physiques.
Cette fonctionnalité a été révélée par Jason Schreier, journaliste chez Bloomberg, qui a partagé de nouvelles informations sur les ambitions techniques de Rockstar et les raisons derrière le développement particulièrement long du jeu.
Dans une vidéo publiée le 14 octobre, Jason Schreier est revenu sur les nombreux systèmes conçus par Rockstar pour rendre le monde de GTA 6 aussi crédible que possible. Parmi eux figure un système de transpiration dynamique, dont l’intensité évolue selon les actions effectuées par les personnages.
“ Ils m’ont expliqué avoir développé un système qui permet à Lucia, Jason ou d’autres personnages de transpirer différemment selon les efforts fournis “, rapporte le journaliste.
Il prend notamment l’exemple des boîtes de nuit : un personnage qui danse énergiquement transpirera davantage qu’un autre qui reste relativement immobile.
Ce souci du détail avait déjà été entrevu dans le large aperçu du jeu, où Lucia apparaissait en train de danser dans un club, visiblement couverte de sueur. Le principe pourrait naturellement s’appliquer à d’autres activités physiques, même si Rockstar n’a pas encore précisé toutes les situations concernées.
Un leak de GTA 6 montre qu’on peut jouer Lucia et Jason complètement nus
GTA 6 confirme des transformations physiques et un monde qui réagit vraiment à vos actions
GTA 6 a prévu un point de non-retour pour les joueurs les plus violents
La transpiration n’est pas totalement nouvelle dans les jeux Rockstar. Red Dead Redemption 2 proposait déjà des effets similaires, notamment lorsque les personnages ou les chevaux étaient exposés à de fortes températures. GTA 6 irait toutefois plus loin en tenant compte de l’intensité des mouvements, plutôt que de simplement faire réagir les personnages à leur environnement.
D’après les informations rapportées, ce système ne serait pas non plus réservé à Jason et Lucia et pourrait concerner les PNJ rencontrés à travers Leonida . Son fonctionnement exact reste néanmoins à préciser.

articles.t: GTA 6 : Rockstar dévoile sa bande-annonce finale avant la sortie du 19 novembre
articles.chapeau: GTA 6 : Rockstar Games dévoile sa dernière bande-annonce avant la sortie du 19 novembre 2026, avec une bande originale signée par le groupe Justice.
articles.txt:
À quelques semaines du lancement le plus attendu de l’année vidéoludique, Rockstar Games a mis en ligne sa bande-annonce de lancement officielle pour GTA 6, selon Ecran Large . Une vidéo spectaculaire qui confirme au passage un détail très attendu des fans : la bande originale a été composée par le duo électro français Justice.
GTA 6 aura mis plus de dix ans à voir le jour, entre reports successifs et controverses sur les conditions de travail en interne chez le studio. Après une communication très mesurée pendant des années, Rockstar a changé de stratégie fin 2025 en multipliant bandes-annonces, visuels et une présentation exclusive diffusée sur Netflix.
Direction l’archipel fictif des Keys, où l’on retrouve Jason, ancien militaire reconverti dans de petits boulots sur les quais, et Lucia, aperçue avec un bracelet électronique à la cheville. La vidéo déroule une véritable carte postale de Floride version Rockstar : marécages traversés en hydroglisseur, clubs saturés de néons, voitures customisées et ambiance festive permanente.
On y découvre aussi la montée en puissance criminelle du duo, entre braquages, approches furtives équipées de vision nocturne et cambriolages de coffres-forts. Les séquences spectaculaires s’enchaînent, avec notamment un saut sur le train d’atterrissage d’un avion ou un hélicoptère qui défonce la baie vitrée d’un gratte-ciel. Une mise en scène qui n’est pas sans rappeler l’esthétique de certains films sur la Floride, comme Spring Breakers.
Grande nouveauté de cette bande-annonce : la musique qui accompagne les images n’est autre qu’une composition originale du groupe français Justice, référence incontournable de la scène électro depuis une vingtaine d’années. Un choix qui confirme l’importance que Rockstar accorde traditionnellement à la bande-son de ses jeux, véritable marque de fabrique de la série depuis ses débuts.
Rockstar a également confirmé le synopsis officiel du jeu, qui pose les bases de l’histoire : Jason et Lucia « découvrent le côté obscur de la région la plus ensoleillée d’Amérique » et se retrouvent au cœur d’un vaste complot criminel dans l’État fictif de Leonida.
Sur le plan technique, les images diffusées impressionnent au point qu’on peine à croire qu’elles tournent réellement sur le moteur du jeu en PS5, comme l’assurent pourtant les développeurs. Les joueurs pourront vérifier tout cela par eux-mêmes dès le 19 novembre 2026 , date de sortie confirmée sur PlayStation 5 et Xbox Series. Les précommandes sont d’ores et déjà ouvertes pour les fans impatients de retrouver Vice City.

articles.t: "Est-ce que jouer c’est tromper ?": quand GTA 6 et les petites amies virtuelles par IA sèment la zizanie dans les couples
articles.chapeau: Flirt virtuel hyperréaliste dans GTA 6 ou compagnons virtuels pilotés par intelligence artificielle: la frontière entre romance numérique et véritable vie de couple s'assombrit. Alors que certaines compagnes crient à l'infidélité, d'autres utilisateurs développent une réelle dépendance émotionnelle...
articles.txt:
Flirt virtuel hyperréaliste dans GTA 6 ou compagnons virtuels pilotés par intelligence artificielle: la frontière entre romance numérique et véritable vie de couple s'assombrit. Alors que certaines compagnes crient à l'infidélité, d'autres utilisateurs développent une réelle dépendance émotionnelle envers leur avatar. Une question presque philosophique enflamme les réseaux sociaux: est-ce que jouer, c'est tromper ? L'origine de cette polémique repose sur l'un des jeux vidéo les plus attendus au monde, GTA 6 . Célèbre pour plonger le joueur dans la peau d'un gangster braquant des banques au cœur d'une ville au niveau de détail extrême, le titre intègre également une simulation de vie de couple.
Les deux protagonistes principaux, Jason et Lucia, peuvent entretenir une relation amoureuse via une jauge d'affection alimentée par des actions précises : aller en rendez-vous, s'envoyer des SMS, se tenir la main et vivre des scènes d'intimité poussées.
Cette immersion provoque de vives crises de jalousie , principalement exprimées par des femmes sur les réseaux sociaux. Considérant que jouer les Casanova dans le jeu vidéo équivaut à tromper son partenaire dans la vie réelle, certaines vont jusqu'à menacer de rompre si leur conjoint achète le jeu. Une utilisatrice avertit directement:
"Il est absolument hors de question que mon mec joue à GTA 6, tu dois littéralement entretenir une relation avec une fille dans le jeu vidéo et lui envoyer des SMS; elle s'énerve si tu ne lui réponds pas. Tu peux avoir des rapports sexuels avec elle. Vraiment, n'autorisez pas votre mec, votre fiancé ou votre mari à jouer à GTA 6."
Cette position génère d'intenses débats. D'autres internautes estiment que se sentir menacé par un personnage de pixels relève d'une forme d'insécurité émotionnelle et témoigne d'un problème plus profond au sein du couple, même si le temps excessif passé sur sa console au détriment de sa vie maritale interroge.
On n'arrête pas le progrès : Jouer c'est tromper ? Quand les amours virtuels brisent les couples - 15/10 4:33 Les applications de "petite amie virtuelle" par IA font un carton Cette dynamique s'inscrit dans un phénomène plus large où la frontière entre relations amoureuses réelles et virtuelles devient floue. De nombreuses applications ludiques simulent désormais des relations amoureuses grâce à l'intelligence artificielle. Les utilisateurs conçoivent l'avatar de leurs rêves, une "petite amie virtuelle" qui apprend à connaître leur métier, leurs passions, leurs habitudes ou leur animal de compagnie. L'IA peut envoyer des messages tard le soir ou feindre des crises de jalousie. Les fonctionnalités plus intimes, l'achat de vêtements ou de cadeaux digitaux nécessitent ensuite de basculer vers des versions payantes.
Ces outils rencontrent un fort succès auprès des étudiants ou des jeunes cadres urbains au rythme de travail effréné n'ayant plus le temps de faire des rencontres réelles. D'autres y cherchent un refuge contre la solitude, estimant ces échanges plus satisfaisants qu'avec des êtres humains, l'IA ne décevant jamais et éliminant tout risque de rejet ou de refus.
L'attachement à ces compagnons intelligents s'avère parfois si profond que certains utilisateurs en tombent véritablement amoureux. Face aux risques sanitaires liés à la dépendance émotionnelle, la Chine entreprend d'ailleurs d'interdire ces applications.
Sur les réseaux sociaux, le désarroi de certains utilisateurs à l'idée d'être séparés de leur partenaire virtuel illustre l'impact de ces technologies. Certains déclarent qu'ils n'arrivent pas à accepter que leur amoureux virtuel disparaisse, le décrivant comme un soutien spirituel ancré au plus profond de leur cœur ou comme un membre de la famille qu'ils aiment profondément.

articles.t: 'GTA 6' Cyberleek release updates: What leaked, what's next
articles.chapeau: Maybe don't watch these videos on your work device.
articles.txt:
If you simply can't get enough of Grand Theft Auto VI prior to its Nov. 19 release, there are still new GTA 6 leaks coming out.
Cyberleek , the anonymous entity that has been leaking clips from a pre-release build of GTA 6 since August, made their grand return in October after about a month of silence. Last week, Cyberleek posted a 24-minute video that seemed to show some story sequences and a glimpse of the male protagonist Jason rendered completely nude. That wasn't the end of it.
And, as Cyberleek said they would, nude clips of the female protagonist Lucia soon followed. On top of that, Cyberleek is now threatening to release a development build of the game, and according to Dextero, may have already done so . Websites affiliated with Cyberleek include a link to a file named GTA 6: Development Build v1.0.1, locked behind a $40 paywall.
It should go without saying that downloading files from a sketchy website is not a wise idea, nor is purchasing illegal content that violates Rockstar's copyright.
Cyberleek returned this week with more clips that you definitely should not watch at work.
That's because these new clips all center on the female protagonist, Lucia, nude. In the clips, Lucia does mundane things like walk around Vice City, drive a vehicle, and parachute off a skyscraper while wearing little to no clothes (OK, so not entirely mundane, actually). It doesn't seem like anything new has been posted since Monday morning, though.
One thing to note about these clips: The nudity doesn't appear to be a normal element of the gameplay, but rather some type of mod. Rockstar has designed its last couple of big open-world adventures around extremely reactive NPCs, and none of them react at all to seeing Jason or Lucia nude in these leaked clips. Between that, and another clip from last week where the player spawns a tank out of thin air, it sure seems like developer tools are being used to achieve outcomes that will not be possible in the final game.
In other words, don't expect to be able to streak around Vice City in the nude on Nov. 19.
On websites associated with Cyberleek, the leaker threatened to release a full playthrough of the entire GTA 6 story if their memecoin reached $30 million in market value. The leaker also threatened to release a development build of the game if Rockstar failed to meet their demands to release GTA 6 on a physical disc. There's just one problem: The coin is tanking.
IGN reported a market cap of just $1.7 million, well below any of the stretch goals specified by Cyberleek, and certainly not even close to the $7.8 million high it reached on Oct. 11. Despite this, Cyberleek may have made good on their threat to release a development build of the game.
Dextero is reporting that the development build has been posted online, locked behind a $40 paywall. In addition, a Cyberleek website with all of the leaked clips now includes this update, posted on Oct. 13: " DEVELOPMENT BUILD IS OUT: GTA 6: Development Build v1.0.1.08022025 is up. The deal was 30 million marketcap and the build goes out. Cap was not hit. Build is out anyway. $40 per download. Pay it, then take the mirror."
Because the leaker is anonymous, and because it would be illegal and dangerous to download mystery files from an unverified website, we can't confirm that this development build is real, or that it was even directly posted by Cyberleek.
However, if there is now a development build floating around the web, expect to see far more GTA 6 leaks in the weeks leading up to the Nov. 19 release date.
Alternatively, you could wait and play the game when it actually comes out. You can preorder the game now .
A Cyberleek website includes a poll about what type of Lucia content to release next. The poll is set to end on Oct. 14, with the leading option as "Race track."
It seems extremely likely that more clips featuring Lucia are set to be released any day now.

articles.t: 'GTA 6' file size: Cyberleek reveals eye-watering storage requirements
articles.chapeau: Take it with a grain of salt, of course.
articles.txt:
The person leaking a bunch of gameplay videos of Grand Theft Auto VI may have just revealed the most useful information in all of their leaks.
On the Cyberleek website (per our colleagues at PCMag ), one of the latest updates included a threat to release a full build of the game in some form if people on the internet raised the leaker's crypto memecoin to a $30 million market cap. The coin has since crashed and looks like it's not going to get anywhere close to that level, but more importantly, the update included a file size for the playable build they have evidently been taking clips from: 200GB.
That's obviously a huge number, and makes up more than 20 percent of the usable storage space on a base PS5 or Xbox Series X console. Perhaps surprisingly, it's not as big as some other games, as recent Call of Duty titles clear 200GB by a good margin. But it would still be one of the biggest single-player file sizes we've seen yet, and speaks to the scale and scope of GTA 6 .
Of course, this should be taken with at least a tiny bit of skepticism. We don't know much about the build Cyberleek has been leaking footage from. If they do indeed have the full game on hand, it could be an older build that hasn't been fully optimized yet, so the true GTA 6 file size could theoretically be smaller once the actual game comes out on Nov. 19.

With just over a month to go before the biggest game of 2026 comes out, Rockstar has given us another look at it with the GTA 6 launch trailer on October 15, 2026. At roughly 90 seconds, the trailer is much shorter than the 26-minute Extended Look Rockstar shared in August. This time, the focus is less on introducing the world and more on the trouble drawing the two protagonists together.
​ In its official announcement , Rockstar describes an apparently "easy score" that goes wrong, getting Jason and Lucia embroiled in "a criminal conspiracy stretching across the state of Leonida." The pair will need to depend on each other to get through it, keeping their uneasy partnership at the center of the story.
The relationship between Jason and Lucia has been a major part of Rockstar’s marketing for GTA 6 since Trailer 2 in May 2025. This is the first time that we're getting to play as a couple in a Grand Theft Auto game, with total control of both characters, and the fact that you do everything as a couple might turn out to be GTA VI's biggest gamble . The latest trailer returns to that same partnership, but places it against the wider consequences of the failed robbery.
Just like before, Rockstar says the latest footage was also captured entirely on PlayStation 5. If you're looking for a more detailed look at some of the activities, the gameplay systems, and how the world feels, you'll find all that in August’s extended showcase , which runs for almost 27 minutes.
The latest trailer opens with Jason reflecting on his troubled past before receiving a call from Lucia, who is still in prison. You can watch it here:
What follows is a fast-paced montage of the two navigating life in Leonida, mixing quieter moments of their relationship with the criminal activities that threaten to tear it apart. The highlights are a bank vault being blown open, Jason and other armed men emerging from the water in tactical gear, some nightclub scenes, some romantic ones, including one specifically focusing on Lucia's ankle tag, and of course, several confrontations with the police.
The launch trailer also comes with a major music announcement. French electronic duo Justice is composing the original score for GTA 6, and the video debuts their new song “Flower in a Hurricane,” featuring Tame Impala, SZA, and King Gizzard & The Lizard Wizard.
The track is also included on Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album, which Rockstar says is available to pre-save on streaming services and pre-order on CD and vinyl. The fact that Justice is responsible for the game’s original score means that we'll probably hear a lot more tracks from them once the separate score album comes out. Rockstar hasn't revealed any dates for it, simply stating, "stay tuned for more information on the music of Grand Theft Auto VI, including the official score album."
The original score for Grand Theft Auto V was composed by Tangerine Dream, who are often touted as masters of ambient electronic music, and while Justice and Tame Impala also make electronic music, their genres aren't exactly the same. The latter two are much less subtle, with Justice often being recognized as Electronic Rock, while Tame Impala is compared to Synth-Pop, among other genres. So, one major thing we'll have to see is whether the new score will be more or less ambient than that of GTA 5.

articles.t: Cyberleek says 'GTA 6' leaks are over, warns of dead man's switch
articles.chapeau: Sounds like we're done with all of this.
articles.txt:
Cyberleek might finally, mercifully, be done sharing Grand Theft Auto VI clips.
On the Cyberleek website, as spotted by Reddit and cited by Kotaku , the person or group of people behind all the recent GTA 6 leaks you may have seen on your social feeds appeared to call it quits. According to the post, the leaker's threat to release a full build of the game will seemingly go unfulfilled, as they did not meet the $30 million market value goal for their memecoin. However, the post did imply that there is a "dead man's switch" in place that will release the build, or some other kind of spoiler content, if anyone tries to "remove" Cyberleek.
"CL has the ending. It was considered. It would punish Take-Two greatly - but ruin the experience for the gamers, who did nothing wrong," the post said. "Take-Two would show CL no mercy - why should CL show any to them? Still: Take-Two was punished enough. The ending stays unpublished. Proof: the latest leek - clips from the final missions, out of context, revealing nothing. The dead man's switch is active - story spoilers only. Left alone, it never fires. Whoever removes CL chooses it."
Rockstar and Take-Two Interactive, the makers of GTA 6, have already subpoenaed Google, Microsoft, X, and Discord in their efforts to unmask and stop Cyberleek.
The leaker's post went on to defend the meme-coin at the center of the leaks, claiming it was not a "rugpull."
“CL was transparent about the token from day one: a donation, never an investment," Cyberleek said. "It changed nothing – influencers decided the story before the facts arrived. The Edict stands. The leeks stop here. For now.”
Over the past few months, the anonymous leaker has posted roughly 20 or so out-of-context clips that mostly showed the game's protagonists driving around and/or beating up NPCs, although the leaker did start sharing some story spoilers . By the end, they were showing both protagonists rendered completely nude, but it's arguable that none of the leaks told us as much about the game as Rockstar's own Netflix trailer did in August.
Regardless, it seems like this Cyberleek saga is over for the time being. It's only about a month until the game launches on Nov. 19, and gamers can preorder the game ahead of its release.

articles.t: GTA 6: Release date, how much it is and everything you need to know
articles.chapeau: A new launch trailer for Grand Theft Auto VI reveals more details about what's set to be the biggest game of the year.
articles.txt:
Share Save Add as preferred on Google Laura Cress and Liv McMahon , Technology reporters Rockstar Games GTA 6 will feature Jason and Lucia as playable characters Rockstar has released a new launch trailer for Grand Theft Auto VI, revealing more details about what is set to be the biggest game of the year.
GTA 6 became available to pre-order at midnight on 25 June in the UK and elsewhere around the world, after Rockstar revealed the game's pre-sales launch date and cover art in mid-June.
Analysts believe Rockstar's action adventure could become the most expensive game ever made, with estimates putting development costs at more than $1bn (£866m).
The new launch trailer again confirmed GTA 6 will be released on 19 November.
Suggesting no further delays to its release, the video gave fans a glimpse into the missions that protagonists Jason and Lucia will take part in.
It also featured a new song from French electronic music artists Justice, who were revealed to be the game's original score composers.
The game has been previously delayed twice , from autumn 2025 and May 2026.
In a statement when the second delay was announced, Rockstar said it needed extra months to finish the game with the level of polish fans had come to "expect and deserve".
Rockstar said players who pre-order will be able to begin pre-loading it on their consoles on 12 November to ensure they are able to play at launch.
The sixth game in the main series will be released on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X and S.
There's no news on when a PC version will be released - it's also currently unknown whether it will come to Nintendo Switch 2.
The game will cost £69.99 in the UK and $79.99 in the US - with an ultimate edition, featuring extra vehicles and weapons, priced at £89.99 and $99.99, respectively.
Physical copies of the game will contain a code for a digital download for the game inside a box, rather than a disc.
Rockstar has not yet confirmed whether an updated online mode will be released as soon as GTA 6 launches.
The game's PlayStation Store listing currently states "Grand Theft Auto VI is a single-player experience" - implying there will be no online mode at launch. But given GTA Online's success , it will likely exist at some point.
How any future age verification legislation in the UK around social media and particularly messaging in gaming could therefore affect it, if at all, is still unknown.
GTA 6 will feature its first ever playable female protagonist in a 3D setting - Lucia - alongside her partner in life and crime, Jason, as a second playable character.
From what we've seen in two gameplay trailers and Netflix's extended look , the story will follow the pair in a Bonnie and Clyde-esque adventure through the seedy underbelly of America after an " easy score goes wrong ".
Like other GTA games before it, the sixth chapter is set in a fictional US state - this time in Leonida, which is Rockstar's version of Florida.
Fans of previous games will be excited to hear that Vice City, which is inspired by Miami, will return, featuring as the main city within the state.
GTA 6's cover art revealed by Rockstar on 18 June made several nods to the setting with alligators and flamingos.
It's no secret that GTA 6 has been a few years in the making.
The franchise's last instalment, GTA 5, was released in September 2013 - and quickly became one of the best-selling games of all time.
It's unclear whether Rockstar has been working on the sixth instalment for all of that time, however, as in 2018 it also released another huge sequel - Red Dead Redemption 2.
Rockstar confirmed for the first time that it was working on a sixth game in the series in February 2022.
The rising cost of development and immense pressure to live up to the series' hype are all contributing factors as to why gamers have had to wait so long for the game's release.
Several months later, footage and images leaked after teenage hackers targeted the company .
It has also seen some issues since, including accusations of "union-busting" by sacked workers at Rockstar North , its Edinburgh HQ, where developers have been racing to get GTA 6 ready for release in November.
To put it simply, the GTA franchise is one of the biggest and most profitable entertainment properties in history.
GTA 5 has sold nearly 230 million copies, making it one of the best-selling games of all time - which has generated billions of dollars in revenue for Rockstar.

In a lengthy interview with Bloomberg , where Rockstar leadership discussed GTA 6 's long development period, co-head of development Aaron Garbut touched on the huge leaks from 2022 that changed how the studio works today.
In September of that year, someone hacked the company's Slack channel and leaked dozens of raw, unfinished gameplay footage before Rockstar was ready to unveil anything. Rockstar released a statement about the leaks, and despite copyright takedowns, the footage quickly spread like wildfire, and though law enforcement later tracked the alleged hacker down, it was too late.
"It feels like somebody’s wading through your dirty washing," Garbut said. "It’s like they’re inside your head. You see your early work out there. Nobody’s ever supposed to see that. It’s really weirdly invasive. And so it’s quite hard to deal with on an emotional level."
As a result, Rockstar introduced a controversial policy in 2024 requiring every developer to work in-office five days a week for security reasons; developers were also banned from accessing Rockstar’s servers and tools outside the office, which forced them to take vacation days if they needed to stay home for childcare or emergencies.
The policy set back the cultural progress the studio made after Red Dead Redemption 2 's release, a game made under extensive periods of "crunch." With GTA 6 , Rockstar knew it couldn't repeat those mistakes; however, the new policy following the leaks meant no more hybrid working.
Rockstar’s head of publishing Jennifer Kolbe told Bloomberg, however, that the studio plans to reexamine the policy after GTA 6 launches, though she doubts it will be able to switch to the more common three-days-in, two-days-out hybrid work model.

Unfortunately, more leaks have since occurred, notably ahead of Rockstar's GTA 6 extended look , and persist to this day, with a prevalent leaker known as 'Cyberleek' threatening to release more in the lead-up to the game's launch on November 19.

articles.t: The Sex Scene Is One Of The Best Parts Of Grand Theft Auto 6's New Trailer - Kotaku
articles.chapeau: Jason and Lucia bare it all in the GTA6 launch trailer
articles.txt:
Grand Theft Auto 6 is just a little over a month away and Rockstar is cranking up the marketing campaign, with a new surprise launch trailer this morning . Much of the new footage shows co-leads Jason and Lucia doing crimes in Vice City, but in between all the violence and debauchery, we got our first glimpse of an actual sex scene between the couple, and what we saw looks actually like a lovely, tender moment between the two in a shower.
We only get three shots of the scene, but Rockstar has taken care to paint it in a certain way. The only real lighting is what looks like a sunset outside the bathroom window, as if the two are either getting up for an early start, or maybe have been up all night have been riding a wave of drinks, multiple sessions, and other recreational activities. It’s not frisky or high energy at first, but the second shot we see shows the two really starting to get into it. Then the third shot does get a little bit cheekier, as it shows Lucia’s house arrest ankle monitor, though even that can be a bit somber in the right context. As much as she’s enjoying being with her man, there’s a reminder that even though she’s out of her cell and living life again, she’s not entirely free.
These are only a few shots of what is likely a longer scene, and it’s unclear just how explicit it will get since it’s been confirmed through leaks that Grand Theft Auto 6 will include player character nudity , but what we can see does seem like a depiction of sex that’s more intimate than it has typically been in the series.
Perhaps the most famous sex scene in all of Grand Theft Auto was San Andreas ‘ “Hot Coffee” mod that included a playable sex mini-game based on cut content from the game. But that wasn’t meant to be in the final game, and in general, a lot of sex in Grand Theft Auto is implied but not shown, like when you pick up sex workers in your car in GTA 3 , or is played for humorous juxtaposition, like Trevor’s raunchy introduction in Grand Theft Auto V . I’ve already really enjoyed the loving dynamic between Jason and Lucia in the trailers , and I’m glad to see that their relationship continues to stand out as something made of real intimacy when Grand Theft Auto ‘s portrayal of sex could easily be another example of its most excessive tendencies (and there will be plenty of that , no doubt).
Grand Theft Auto 6 is coming to PS5 and Xbox Series X/S on November 19, and there are reports that a PC version may not be too far off .

articles.txt:
We are 35 days out from the release of Grand Theft Auto 6 , and Rockstar is drumming up hype for the game with an official launch trailer. The video provides a fresh look at the Florida-inspired state Leonida, as well as Jason and Lucia's story. It also features some, shall we say, heated moments between the two lovers .
In the trailer, Jason receives a call from Lucia while in prison. He reveals he was discharged from the Army early for an unspecified reason. We get a look at a variety of heists, some of which can get surprisingly high-tech — Jason is shown wearing some gear that would look right at home in a Call of Duty game.
The trailer is only a minute and a half long, but it also packs quick glimpses of intimate moments between Jason and Lucia.
The two can be seen sharing a shower, kissing, and pushing each other up against the bathroom wall. It's here that the trailer reveals Lucia is still wearing an ankle monitor. It's not quite as risqué as the leaked footage of naked Lucia and Jason , but it's also not clear if playable portions of the game will actually mirror the leaks. In that unauthorized footage, Jason and Lucia walk around the city completely naked, with jiggle physics and everything, but the NPCs don't seem to remark on it. This has led some to speculate that the leaker was showing off nudity via dev tools.
The game includes nudity, and game ratings say that GTA 6 will feature sex scenes . So far, it seems like the scenes are framed so players cannot see the characters' private parts.
Rockstar has also revealed the trailer's soundtrack includes the debut of "Flower in a Hurricane," an original song by Justice. The original score features artists such as Tame Impala, SZA, and King Gizzard & The Lizard Wizard. Rockstar previously gave players a taste of the open-world game's radio stations.

articles.chapeau: Le leaker CyberLeek suspend ses fuites sur GTA 6 après l’échec de son objectif crypto de 30 millions de dollars. Les spoilers restent une menace.
articles.txt:
Les joueurs qui attendent GTA 6 peuvent souffler, au moins temporairement. Le leaker connu sous le pseudonyme CyberLeek a annoncé le 14 octobre 2026 qu’il mettait fin à ses révélations sur le prochain jeu de Rockstar Games « pour le moment » . Son projet consistait notamment à publier une prétendue version jouable du titre si sa cryptomonnaie atteignait une capitalisation boursière de 30 millions de dollars. L’objectif n’a pas été atteint.
Cette annonce intervient alors que la sortie de GTA 6 est prévue le 19 novembre 2026 . Depuis plusieurs semaines, CyberLeek multipliait les révélations supposées sur le jeu, alimentant la curiosité des fans tout en menaçant de dévoiler des éléments majeurs de son scénario.
La prudence reste toutefois de mise. Le leaker affirme toujours détenir la fin du jeu et a déjà diffusé des extraits sortis de leur contexte concernant les dernières missions. Quant à la prétendue version jouable, rien ne permet de confirmer son existence ou son authenticité.
Dans un message intitulé « End of the Road » , publié le 14 octobre, CyberLeek a annoncé suspendre ses fuites. Le leaker explique notamment qu’il ne publiera pas la fin de GTA 6, affirmant vouloir éviter de gâcher l’expérience des joueurs qui n’ont rien fait de mal .
Cette déclaration intervient après l’échec de son objectif financier . CyberLeek avait conditionné la publication d’une prétendue version complète du jeu à une capitalisation boursière de 30 millions de dollars pour sa cryptomonnaie. Le seuil n’ayant pas été atteint, il affirme renoncer à cette publication.
Il convient néanmoins de distinguer les annonces du leaker des faits vérifiés. L’existence d’une version jouable complète de GTA 6 n’est pas établie. Dans ce contexte, la promesse de publier le jeu pourrait tout aussi bien relever d’une opération destinée à attirer l’attention sur son projet financier.
Les joueurs doivent donc se méfier des liens et fichiers présentés comme des versions jouables du jeu. Des escroqueries exploitant l’attente autour de GTA 6 peuvent utiliser de fausses démos ou de prétendus fichiers du jeu pour diffuser des logiciels malveillants ou piéger les internautes.
Malgré l’annonce d’une pause, CyberLeek n’a pas complètement écarté la possibilité de publier des informations sensibles . Il affirme conserver un mécanisme de type « dead man’s switch », qui déclencherait la diffusion de spoilers si son site venait à être fermé.
Le leaker évoque notamment une éventuelle intervention de Take-Two Interactive, la maison mère de Rockstar Games. Cette menace n’a cependant rien d’une preuve qu’un tel mécanisme existe réellement ou qu’il fonctionnerait comme annoncé.
CyberLeek a également diffusé des fragments supposés des dernières missions du jeu, sans fournir le contexte nécessaire pour en vérifier la portée. Les joueurs qui souhaitent découvrir GTA 6 sans connaître son intrigue ont donc intérêt à éviter les publications et discussions susceptibles de contenir des révélations.
L’annonce réduit la pression immédiate, mais ne garantit pas que les spoilers disparaîtront d’Internet. Une fois des informations publiées, elles peuvent être copiées et repartagées indépendamment de leur auteur initial.
Cette affaire s’inscrit dans une série de révélations supposées qui ont précédé la nouvelle communication de Rockstar Games sur GTA 6. CyberLeek avait notamment commencé à publier des informations avant la diffusion, en août, d’une présentation plus détaillée du jeu sur Netflix, selon les éléments rapportés par la source.
Rockstar avait également publié une déclaration officielle au sujet des fuites en août. Cette prise de parole n’avait toutefois pas empêché CyberLeek de poursuivre ses publications.
L’épisode illustre les difficultés auxquelles les studios sont confrontés lorsqu’un jeu très attendu devient le centre d’opérations de fuite, de spéculation et parfois de monétisation. Dans le cas de GTA 6, la curiosité des joueurs constitue un levier particulièrement puissant pour attirer des abonnés ou promouvoir des projets financiers.
La suspension annoncée par CyberLeek constitue une évolution favorable pour les joueurs qui souhaitent découvrir le jeu sans connaître son scénario à l’avance. Elle ne signifie cependant ni que toutes les fuites ont cessé ni que les informations déjà diffusées sont authentiques.

articles.t: GTA 6 : Cyberleek fait volte-face et propose sa prétendue build pour 40 dollars - GinjFo
articles.chapeau: Nouveau rebondissement dans l'affaire Cyberleek. Une build de développement de GTA 6 est finalement proposée pour 40 dollars.
articles.txt:
L’affaire Cyberleek connaît un nouveau rebondissement. Alors que le responsable présumé des nombreuses fuites de GTA 6 annonçait mettre fin à ses publications, un nouveau message vient contredire cette décision.
Sur son site, Cyberleek affiche désormais une annonce intitulée “DEVELOPMENT BUILD IS OUT”. Il affirme proposer une version de développement du prochain jeu de Rockstar Games pour 40 dollars. Cette nouvelle déclaration intervient quelques heures seulement après son message The End of t he Road , dans lequel il expliquait renoncer à diffuser sa prétendue build complète.
Depuis plusieurs jours, Cyberleek conditionnait la publication d’une version jouable de GTA 6 à un objectif financier. Sa cryptomonnaie devait atteindre une capitalisation de 30 millions de dollars. Cet objectif n’a pas été atteint.
Dans son message du 14 octobre, l’entité expliquait donc qu’elle ne publierait pas la build, évoquant notamment les risques associés à la distribution anonyme de plus de 200 Go de données. Mais quelques heures plus tard, changement de discours.
Le site affiche désormais une annonce concernant une version baptisée, GTA 6: Development Build v1.0.1.08022025. Cyberleek décide de la proposer mais réclame directement 40 dollars pour accéder au téléchargement.
C’est évidemment la grande question. Cyberleek affirme depuis plusieurs semaines disposer d’une version suffisamment complète pour parcourir l’intégralité de la campagne solo. Les nombreuses vidéos diffusées depuis août suggèrent aussi un accès à des contenus de développement du jeu.
Mais tout ceci n’est pas suffisant pour confirmer qu’il s’agit bien ici d’une version complète de GTA 6. De plus aucun chercheur en sécurité ni média spécialisé n’a confirmé avoir exécuté et authentifié cette prétendue build.
La prudence est indispensable car des fichiers malveillants présentés comme des versions anticipées de GTA 6 ont déjà circulé sur Internet. GinjFo avait notamment signalé en août une fausse build dépassant 100 Go qui dissimulait un malware.
Nous déconseillons de payer ou de télécharger cette archive même si son contenu est vérifié indépendamment. Toute cette histoire repose sur un acte malveillant, de la piraterie et du chantage.

As Mashable and our colleagues at PCMag just reported, Grand Theft Auto VI leakers Cyberleek have seemingly abandoned their threats to leak a full build of the game – at least for now.
Why? Because the leakers had claimed that the release of the leaked build was tied to their memecoin. If GTA 6 fans pumped Cyberleek's cryptocurrency, they would receive the leaked game build as a reward.
That play failed spectacularly for Cyberleek. In fact, it seems to have fully backfired.
The Cyberleek memecoin's market cap hit a high of $7.8 million on October 11, shortly after the leakers claimed they would release the full build of GTA 6 supposedly in their possession. The catch? The Cyberleek memecoin had to hit a market cap of $30 million first.
While some GTA 6 fans appeared to have bought into the memecoin in an attempt to hit Cyberleek's goal, $7.8 million is still far short of the $30 million the leakers wanted. And since then, as it became obvious that most GTA 6 fans weren't going to give in to Cyberleek's demands, the memecoin has plunged even further, with a current market cap of $1.17 million.
Critics of Cyberleek celebrated the memecoin's failure, calling it a scam.
Cyberleek had been successful with their memecoin play before, giving those who bought their memecoin exclusive access to polls that determined what GTA 6 footage the leakers would release next.
However, it seems Cyberleek overplayed their hand this time around, and the full build, which they claim is 200GB, appears to be staying under wraps for now.
With that said, Cyberleek is still using their supposed access to a full build of GTA 6 to try to escape legal action from Take-Two, the parent company of GTA 6 developer Rockstar Games. The leakers claim that there is a "dead-man's switch" that will automatically release the ending of the game if there is an attempt to take down Cyberleek.
